title: Computed properties, and when a watcher is the wrong tool

videos.script:
Most of what a screen shows is not stored anywhere. It is worked out. The total of the week, the sessions in it, the courses that match a search. {{derived}} This lesson is about the tool for those, computed.

{{cache}} A computed runs only when somebody reads it, and only again after something it read has changed. You will watch it skip work it does not need to do.

{{setter}} Then a computed you can write to, for one value shown in two shapes, minutes and hours.

{{watcher}} Then the mistake this lesson's title warns about. Keeping a total in step with a watcher. You will see it show zero on the first render, and miss a change completely.

{{pure}} Then the rule a computed lives by. It reads, and it returns, and it changes nothing. One line of sort will break that rule without a single warning.

{{planner}} And then the planner adds up the week. Every number on its screen comes from one new value, the Monday you are looking at.
